overall: The AG found the Board's March 18 notice failed to clearly identify an anticipated executive session on the Daley discrimination matter, a violation, but accepted the Board's release of the executive session minutes as adequate remedy and ordered no further relief.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board held an unnoticed executive session at its March 18 meeting concerning a discrimination complaint.
Whether the Board posted the meeting notice in the proper location, which the AG reviewed as an initial matter.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board posted notice in the proper location by posting to the bulletin board at Town Hall, in accordance with G.L. c. 30A, § 20(c).

allegations.summary: Not raised by the complaint: the Board discussed liability insurance coverage in executive session under the mediation purpose, which the AG flagged as inappropriate.
allegations.key_passage: we note that G.L. c. 30A, § 21(a)(9), is not an appropriate executive session purpose for discussing liability insurance coverage with respect to a claim where the Board has not taken a prior public vote to enter into mediation with the claimant.
